title: The system, not the whole universe, is what is conscious

statements.text: The whole universe may still hold records, such as waste heat, that tell two histories apart. But process theories assign consciousness to a bounded system from its own properties, and the system's local state, a projection of the global state, discards those records. So the leftover traces outside the system do not rescue the attribution.

sources.quote: the projection discards from the present state the very degrees of freedom that distinguish one history from another
The distinction between global state (Γ𝑡) and local state (𝑋𝑡 ) is essential.
